fixes.what: Inside .descend__trunk, 100% resolves to the strip's own 20vw box, not the viewport, so the right strip's inset/mask math is wrong: use inset(0 0 0 0) (the strip is already 20vw) and a mask that fades toward the column edge: linear-gradient(to left, #000 calc(100% - 72px), transparent 100%) mirrored from the left strip; verify at 1024/1280/1440.
fixes.why: The right trunk shows a hard edge at some widths.

fixes.what: Add ScrollTrigger.config({limitCallbacks:true}); make .reveal/.stagger triggers that are already above the viewport after an anchor jump or programmatic scroll resolve immediately (set once:true triggers to their end state when start < scroll position).
fixes.why: Anchor links (#inquire) can leave reveals invisible when the trigger was skipped.
The fixed z-index:60 motion toggle covers the last lines of the open panel at 390px.

fixes.what: Do not mutate aria-hidden/tabIndex synchronously inside the scroll handler; guard with !el.contains(document.activeElement) and set them in the settle timeout only.
fixes.why: Changing aria-hidden under focus during scroll drops focus and churns the a11y tree.

fixes.what: Give the canopy img fetchpriority=high, and make the preload's imagesrcset/imagesizes match the img's srcset/sizes byte-for-byte.
fixes.why: A mismatched preload is fetched twice or ignored.

note: Captured from the Gemini web app (4 Argon) on the pass-5 build; 6th fix truncated in capture.
